notes.title: Update №2
notes.content:
DevBlog 2 – Alpha 5.5

1) Added entering the name of your restaurant business.

2)Added icons red over the buildings of the competitors (so far it's just the icons).

3) Now for$ 11,000 that are given at the start of the game, you need to pay a loan. At the end of the day will be charged$ 100 from your account, as well as it can be paid in the Bank window.

4)now the Bank has its own name " Dynasty Bank”

5) Optimized system of language change, no more errors were observed.

notes.title: Update №1
notes.content:
1) Reduced the size of the icons in the "Product Warehouse" window

2) Increased time reduction in products in stock

3) A pot is added to the game. Of the available opportunities, only the contribution of money to the bank is ready

4) More people have been added to the map

5) Removed minor bugs and changed the icon in the window "Market share"
